subject: Probabilistic programming in industry: looking for cool **industry** use cases

messages.author: 1a4dbc15f9599d86
messages.subject: Probabilistic programming in industry: looking for cool **industry** use cases
parts:
Hi all, 

I work for a ML R&D startup. We publish quarterly reports on cool stuff in ML, stats, and CS and build fully functional prototypes using (usually) public data. Currently, we're working on a report (and prototype) on probabilisitic programming. Needless to say, we've been working with stan a lot. Now, we're looking for companies, we'd get most excited about startups, that use probabilistic programming in interesting ways to solve industry problems (my apologies for this somewhat off-topic message). 

We've found probabilisitic programming is widely used in academic settings (in a previous life, during a postdoc stint, I used Bayesian approaches to study human cognition). It seems like it's found fewer applications in the industry so far. Of course we believe there is tremendous potential, hence our excitement.

So, if you work with probabilistic programming in an industry setting (or if you know of people that do), I'd love to chat with you about the application of these approaches to real datasets (any experiences, good or bad). The goal is to highlight cool use cases in our report other than the one we'll demonstrate in our prototype (as well as giving some exposure to companies that do interesting work). Please reply to the thread and I'll reach out to you. Thanks! :)

- Friederike
